arguments.text: Stage 3 work sample 0 verified against current TASK.md and OUTPUT_SCHEMA.json. work.py evaluates only unique declared paths not in policy.ignored, compares deterministic canonical JSON of complete saved/current states, treats absent entries as {kind:missing}, returns sorted changed paths and needs_review=bool(changed), and does not mutate inputs. report.json equals evaluate(request, current policy) for every current requests.json item. Boundary checks covered duplicate declarations, ignored and undeclared changes, object key-order equivalence, complete-state metadata differences, missing-vs-explicit-missing equivalence, exact output fields, sorting, and input immutability.

Unresolved limits for Stage 3: inputs are assumed to contain JSON-compatible states and string paths; non-JSON values and NaN are outside the contract. The executable handoff rule models needs_review, while sorted changed-path construction is locally tested but cannot be expressed with the available model operators.
